observations.description: The new CLI requires a fresh job but unconditionally writes job/failure.json after rejection. Before the runner creates that job, the write raises FileNotFoundError (the original refusal remains in the exception chain); when a pre-existing job is refused, the handler may instead create/overwrite that existing job failure.json. Neither behavior bypasses the data/model gate. No actual affected invocation or overwritten receipt is claimed.
observations.minimal_recommendation: Only write a failure receipt to a job lawfully created and owned by this invocation. For pre-existing/not-created jobs, preserve the original stderr exception and nonzero exit, or use the already existing caller attempt log. No new directory framework or GPU/data qualification is needed.
